{{Quote|Captain Drayk and Sergeants Ven and Ando are coordinating what's left of our troops ''[sic]'' but I need to get back out there. It's going to take hours to clean up the mess Grievous has left behind here.|Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="gambit" />}}
'''Ando''' was the name of a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ando was part of a [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] that was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] to stop a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] invasion. Ando fought in the ensuing [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]], which became difficult for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] since the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] introduced a [[Grievous's computer virus|computer virus]] that [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] all Republic communications. Despite the new weapon, the Republic was eventually successful in repelling the attacks. Following the battle, Ando stayed with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Drayk (clone trooper)|Drayk]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Ven (Battle of Kothlis)|Ven]] on Kothlis to coordinate the remaining [[Troop/Legends|troops]].

==Biography==
The [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] nicknamed Ando was one of the many [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]<ref name="gambit" /> of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] that were bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="databank" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' dates the events of ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'' to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] to the planet [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. Ando and their [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] were part of the fleet and were ordered to defend the planet from an [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|attack]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] led by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. When the Republic fleet arrived near Kothlis, Grievous made use of a [[Grievous's computer virus|computer virus]] that [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] all Republic communications.<ref name="gambit" />

Although their mission was complicated by the virus, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] ordered an attack in retaliation. Aboard the Republic [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Indomitable (Republic cruiser)|''Indomitable'']], Ando and their comrades boarded [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] and landed on Kothlis, where they fought against deployed Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Due to the superior number of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|ground troops]] suffered heavy losses. However, the [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] aboard the ''Indomitable'' were able to restore the communications that were being blocked by the computer virus, and the Republic fleet drove Grievous and his fleet out of the [[Star system/Legends|system]], forcing him to abandon his plans of capturing Kothlis. After the Confederate fleet had withdrawn, Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] supported the ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]], and the Republic was victorious.<ref name="gambit" />

The attack from the Confederacy left heavy casualties, and the remaining Republic troops had to be coordinated. Because Kenobi had been injured during the battle, Ando received the order to oversee the clearing work in conjunction with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Drayk (clone trooper)|Drayk]] and Clone [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Ven (Battle of Kothlis)|Ven]]. In accordance with the command, they remained on Kothlis.<ref name="gambit" />

==Personality and traits==
Sergeant Ando was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] clone raised and trained on the planet Kamino and, like all clone troopers, they stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> Ando fought for the Galactic Republic's Grand Army and gained an order from Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to coordinate the remaining Republic troops with the help of Captain Drayk and Sergeant Ven.<ref name="gambit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ando was mentioned in the novel ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', a tie-in novel for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The novel was published in [[2010]] and written [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="gambit" />
